# Always cite standards

When a PR touches code that traces to a standard (anything tagged in `docs/traceability.csv` or under `slave/src/core/`, `slave/src/profiles/`, `master/src/tethys_master/protocol/`), the commit body must cite the standard section.

## Required citation format

```text
<conventional-commit subject line>

<body paragraph(s)>

Cite: ASAM XCP 1.4 Part 2 §1.3.2.4
Cite: ISO 26262-6:2018 §6.4.3
Cite: ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 §5.4.3.1
Trace: docs/traceability.csv row TETHYS-REQ-0042
```

Multiple `Cite:` lines allowed (and encouraged when one change touches multiple standards). `Trace:` lines point at specific `docs/traceability.csv` row IDs.

## Recognised standards

The full list lives in [`docs/research/phase-0-standards-matrix.csv`](../../docs/research/phase-0-standards-matrix.csv) (S1-S35). Common cites:

- `ASAM XCP 1.4` (S1)
- `MISRA C:2023` (no S-number; project-wide gate)
- `ISO 26262-{1..12}:2018` (S9)
- `IEC 61508-{1..7}` (S7)
- `IEC 61784-3 ed.4` (S8)
- `CCSDS 232.1-B-2 (COP-1)` (S10)
- `ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1` (S18)
- `IACS UR E22 Rev.3` (S11)
- `DO-178C` (S22)

## When NOT to cite

- Refactor that preserves semantics.
- Docs-only changes (the docs themselves cite standards inline).
- Scaffold / CI / pre-commit / lint config.

## CI enforcement (lands in PR-4)

`pr-title.yml` workflow includes a body-content check: when the PR diff touches a path tracked by `docs/traceability.csv`, the PR body must contain at least one `Cite:` or `Trace:` line. Failure blocks merge.
